run_Subprocess: run a command in a subprocess and capture its stdout and stderr output
test_GetTestExecutablePath: test that a given test binary exists at the expected path in the build directory
build_SetEnvVar: build a test harness that sets or unsets environment variables before running subprocesses
review_GetExitStatus: review the exit status of a subprocess to determine if it exited normally or was killed by a signal
create_GetTempDir: create a temporary directory for test artifacts that is automatically cleaned up on exit
